body.name: Branch-indexed switching protocol--slice record \(R_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction: A switching record is \(R_{\mathrm{sw}}=(b_S,b_{\ell},b_K,b_T,(\tau_{\alpha})_{\alpha\in K})\).  Here \(b_S\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathcal A|}\) is a protocol mask, \(b_{\ell}\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathrm{LIT}|}\) is one concrete slice label, \(b_K\in\{0,1\}^{M}\) is the incidence mask of a branch set \(K\subseteq\Omega\), and \(b_T\in\{0,1\}^{V\sqcup(V\times\mathrm{LIT})}\) records one labelled single-district source factor extracted from that slice.  For every owned branch \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in K\), the record contains a self-delimiting ancestor--district transcript \(\tau_{\alpha}\) for that concrete assignment and equality type.  Its fixed-width part has \(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+M+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\) bits.
